title: Are A and B disjoint sets
description:
Given the sets `A = {19, 22, 24, 20, 25, 26}` and `B = {19, 22, 20, 25, 26, 24, 28, 27}`: Are A and B disjoint sets?

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `is_disjoint(a, b)`, returning True if the two sets share no elements at all, False otherwise.
hints: Two sets are disjoint when they have zero elements in common - not even one.
Sets have a dedicated method that answers exactly this question with True or False.
Call a.isdisjoint(b) and return its result directly.
expected_behavior: Returns True if a and b have no elements in common, False if they share at least one element.

hidden_tests.label: A and B share several elements
an empty set is disjoint with anything

explanation: set.isdisjoint() returns True only when the two sets share no elements whatsoever - it's the opposite question from intersection, answered directly as a boolean instead of returning the shared elements themselves.
